{{Quote|The Dark Tuash of Alanciar was my daughter's favorite story of the Return.|[[Gavar Khai]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>}}
The '''Tuash'aa of Alanciar''' were heralds in the form of [[Tuash'aa|great birds]] in the [[Keshiri religion|folklore]] of the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Species/Legends|race]], believed to carry news of the actions of the fabled [[Destructors]]. While the '''Bright Tuash''' was said to bring positive tidings of the Destructors, the '''Dark Tuash''' was thought of as an omen of foreboding.
